pages.text: $(bold)Reload Facility$()$(br2)A manual station that loads torpedoes or hand-loaded missiles into launchers. It does not automatically resupply players nearby and is not an ammo store.$(br2)The interface has three slots: launcher input, ammo input, loaded output.

$(bold)Rules & Speed$()$(br2)The facility only outputs fully loaded launchers; already-full or partially loaded launchers are rejected. The output slot must be empty to keep working.$(br2)Each reload takes about 10 seconds (200 ticks), same on land and in water. Hopper on top feeds launchers, side feeds ammo, bottom extracts the product.
